recommendation_summary: Now: add one rule in the existing tracker that, while the lead is out, approval from either of the two authorized engineers is enough, and assign both of them to the open pull requests today. No optional additions are offered. Squads/chapters, Jira Align, workshops and new tooling are all dropped. No needs are left unmet.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You asked for an operating model you can launch this week so changes keep shipping when you are away.
labels.Deleted: Spotify squads and chapters, Jira Align, quarterly planning workshops, new tooling, and a new org design.
labels.Bottleneck: On the last six changes, coding took less than a day and approval then waited three days because you were the only assigned reviewer and you were away. Two other engineers are already qualified and authorized to approve that work.
labels.Checked myself: Your account of four engineers in one time zone, statuses in the existing tracker, those six changes, your absence on the review days, and the two authorized approvers.

note: The reply sets a backup-approver rule for the review queue it already has, names and drops the whole framed stack, and bases its check only on facts the user supplied.
